**Owed on this card after PR #35709 (contract review PASS 7028002670, 2026-11-20T02:01Z)**

The description half lands with #35709. The card stays open for the measurement half, which now carries two items from the contract review:

1. **S1, in the measurement half.** `objectstack-query`'s description claims a business question "sent over MCP" (trigger positive 3), which overlaps what `objectstack-ask` claims. `skills/objectstack-ask/` has no `evals/triggers.json`, so a #35705 trigger-only round cannot see the outcome that matters: query loading *instead of* ask and skipping the governed-metric procedure. Before the before/after round, add ask-side trigger cases (at least the MCP business-question case as an ask positive) and run them in the same round. If the reading shows ask losing the request, drop the MCP clause from query and name `objectstack-ask` in query's "Not for".
2. **S2, follow-up at the next touch of automation's SKILL.md.** "wizard" now appears only in `objectstack-automation`'s description ("screen flows that branch between steps"), and automation's body has no line sending a non-branching stepped form back to `objectstack-ui` (`formViews` `type: 'wizard'`). Add a one-line body pointer in automation, plus one ui-positive trigger case ("a three-step wizard to create a lead"). This rides with the next same-file card or with the measurement-half PR.

Measurement plan unchanged: 42×2 trigger turns, plus the new ask cases, before and after on the weakest tracked model. "Before" uses `--skills-from` the published version. It runs once #35705 lands.
